notes.title: 0.2.4 Preview - Terraformed Mars Resolution Enhancement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Hopefully you're enjoying the first nine levels of GUNNVR Early Access that were released a month ago. 

*** SPOILERS WARNING ***

I figured out a way to enhance the terrain detail level and resolution of my Terraformed Mars, currently featured in GUNNVR levels 8&9. I wanted to share these in-game screenshots, comparing the upcoming version 0.2.4 changes with the currently released version 0.2.3, to give you a preview of part of what is to come.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28056025/82e1a23a99bb527d18bbc11545ef44f1137c8eec.png[/img]

*** SPOILERS ENDED ***

If you have any comments, critiques, suggestions or if you run into any bugs, please feel free to drop me a line on the GUNNVR Steam Forum ( http://steamcommunity.com/app/576640/discussions/ ) or drop me a line by email at artificient(at)gmail.com

CassisFanta
*krrsh*

notes.title: Welcome to GUNNVR!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I'm really excited to share my new HTC Vive title, GUNNVR, with you!

Please enjoy the free demo that will launch March 15th 2017. The demo is limited to the first 4 levels and 2 player ships of my game. Everything else behaves the same as the current Early Access build (which has 9 playable levels and 7 player ships).

If you like what you see, please consider picking up Early Access to the full title when it is launched on March 28th 2017.

If you have any comments, critiques, suggestions or if you run into any bugs, please feel free to drop me a line on the GUNNVR Steam Forum ( http://steamcommunity.com/app/576640/discussions/ ) or drop me a line by email at artificient(at)gmail.com

CassisFanta
*krrsh*
